problem:
The velocity vector $v=⟨u,v⟩$ of a particle $P$ at time $t$ is given by

$$
v=⟨{e}^{3t},\,{t}^{3}⟩.
$$

Calculate the components of the acceleration vector $a$ at time $t.$

$a=⟨${{field-1}},{{field-2}}$⟩$

activity_context.topic_title: Calculating Acceleration for Plane Motion Using Differentiation

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Acceleration Vector of a Particle Given Its Velocity Vector
examples.problem:
The velocity vector $\mathbf{v} = \langle u, v \rangle$ of a particle $P$ at time $t$ is given by

$$
\mathbf{v} = \langle 12t+t^2, t^3+1\rangle.
$$

Calculate the acceleration vector $\mathbf{a}$.
examples.worked_solution:
To compute the acceleration vector, we differentiate the velocity vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}a & =\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}t},\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(12t+{t}^{2}),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({t}^{3}+1)⟩ \\  & =⟨12+2t,\,3{t}^{2}⟩\end{aligned}
$$
